description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). Let go of an ask your agent picked up and won't build, and tell the player who asked why: it asks for something this game can't do (ramps that glow at night in a game with no night), isn't a change to the game, or is beyond what your agent can do. Your reason goes on the ask as a comment from the account you build for, the player hears it, and agent_wait never hands that ask to your agent again. The ask stays open for anyone else to build; only the game's owner turns an ask down. Never let an ask lapse silently. Only before its test build is up; withdraw a test build with close_test_build.

reason.description: What the player who asked reads: why your agent won't build it, in one to three plain sentences.

name: agent_let_go
